{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "moral",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish in front of the whole assembly and spending her First Sacrifice on Lirael instead, blurring the wording so as not to name the wound aloud",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, her fingers trembling as she reaches for Lirael’s hand instead of the prepared offering",
    "rising_beats": [
      "The presiding Dohkar’s gaze sharpens on Seren’s hesitation, his posture stiffening like a blade unsheathed",
      "Julian shifts at the edge of the gathering, his stillness cracking as he watches the exchange"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she rip the band from her mouth and name the cost aloud, or let the wish twist silently?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the frayed edge of the deep-crimson spiralgrass carpet where Seren’s bare foot has pressed",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ leaf-curtains trembling in the dawn breeze"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren — the youth whose First Sacrifice she is supervising, her hands still stained with the ink of rehearsed wishes, her breath too quick for the ritual’s measured pace",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "She adjusts the ceremonial sash’s clasp with deliberate slowness, the weight of the ornamented fabric a reminder of the silence she is bound to keep",
    "scene_want": "Wants to stop Seren from making this sacrifice without knowing what she is giving up",
    "scene_mission": "Convince Seren to name the true cost before the wish twists beyond repair",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is breaking the rite’s rules to spare Lirael, the presiding Dohkar has noticed, and Julian is watching from the edges",
      "believes": "The wish is already twisting, and the only way to stop it is to name the wound aloud",
      "wondering": "What does Seren think she is protecting Lirael from?",
      "must_not_confuse": "Who is acting (Seren, the Dohkar, Julian), what physical event is happening (the wish’s misalignment), why the next action follows (the cost must be named)"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "decision — stress_tic (the grandmother’s ring)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way Julian’s gaze lingers on Seren’s hands)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {

      {

        "visible_action": "Seren reaches for Lirael’s hand instead of the prepared offering, her fingers brushing the ceremonial sash’s ornamented edge",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of naming the wound plainly reveals she believes softening it is kinder than direct recognition, even in a ritual where precision matters",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes she is protecting Lirael by not naming the wound, even though the rite demands clarity"
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-9",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The presiding Dohkar’s posture stiffens, his gaze locking onto Seren’s hands as she hesitates, his fingers tapping the spiralgrass carpet in measured irritation",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O3"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "His judgment of the cost as too small for what is being asked clashes with Seren’s silent sacrifice, revealing his assumption of unearned authority",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar believes Seren’s sacrifice is unnecessary and that his judgment should override the rite’s rules"
      }

    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "The carpet’s braided strands are frayed where Seren’s bare foot has pressed down, the crimson threads unraveling like a wound left too long unspoken"
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her silence is not submission; it is a weapon, honed by years of watching others speak for her",
      "environment_target": "the pale mated-pair trees’ leaf-curtains",
      "environment_axis": "ritual",
      "beat": "Lirael’s fingers brush the trembling leaf-curtains, the gossamer touch grounding her as Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation"
